## What's Changed
### Features
* feat(sdk/go): allow anonymous registry auth by @lukaskoebe in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1900
### Fixes
* fix(sdk): let node and go modify set secret policy by @TheRealSibasishBehera in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1880
* fix(network): use published msb smoltcp fork by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1906
* fix(security): update dependencies and redact example output by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1907
* fix(runtime): reclaim the bootstrap trampoline rootfs after the VM exits by @choksi2212 in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1841
* fix(runtime): honor custom filesystem backends by @x0day in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1899
### Dependencies
* chore(deps): Bump the "dependencies" group with 2 updates across multiple ecosystems by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1897
### CI
* ci: compress rust test debug sections by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1912
### Maintenance
* chore: refresh lockfiles after v0.7.9 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1905
* chore: release v0.7.10 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1916
